name: Data-Folder Abbreviation Migration (data/black_diamond->data/bd, data/orion->data/inf) + bd/cot gold full separation
description: Andrew-direct: rename the two mis-named medallion data trees to match the already-abbreviated bucket/pipeline layer -- data/black_diamond/ -> data/bd/ (49 Financial / bd-pipeline) + data/orion/ -> data/inf/ (Inflection / inf-pipeline); data/cot/ already follows the convention. Makes the repo one-token-consistent end to end (data/bd <-> opal-data-bd <-> bd-pipeline <-> bd-v), collapses the compiler's black_diamond<->bd translation tech-debt, and adds mild source-obscurity (Andrew: 'leave them a little vague for security purposes'). NOT massively breaking: runtime is S3-decoupled (scripts I/O opal-data-bd/inf, not local data/ paths), buckets/pipelines/tags UNCHANGED, no S3/TF/data migration, git mv preserves history, single-git-revert reversible. CRITICAL discrimination: rename ONLY the path prefix data/black_diamond/ + data/orion/ -- PRESERVE orion/black_diamond as VENDOR/API names (Orion Advisor Tech REST API: _orion_api_silver_lib.py/orion_export.ts/convert_orion_api_to_silver.py; Black Diamond DataMining) -- a blind sed corrupts the live integration code (same literal-preservation as CW_Transactions in cot).
